author: Scott Manley
description:
There's been quite a few interesting launches in the last couple of weeks with Rocket Lab lauching a rocket in 16 hours, ULA sending up the last of the heavy lift Atlas V's, SpaceX's Starfall, and the Swift Rescue Mission making it to space.

That's of course a small part of the much bigger news!
